title: Scott# 640 8c Ulysses S. Grant Precancel Stamp ~ Los Angeles
descriptionText: The product is a Scott# 640 8c Ulysses S. Grant Precancel Stamp from Los Angeles, California. This stamp, issued between 1921-1930 in the United States, features a historical figure theme and is of olive green color. It is a used stamp with a precancel cancellation type and is uncertified. This collectible item would be a valuable addition to any stamp collection focusing on United States postage issues from the early 20th century.
